Our Story

Twenty-seven years at the bar.

Founded in 1998 by Advocate Saurabh J. Mehta, our firm has grown into one of Gujarat's most respected legal practices.

Mehta Lawyers, founded and led by Advocate Saurabh J. Mehta, is a distinguished law firm based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, offering comprehensive legal services across multiple practice areas. With over 27 years of experience before the Hon'ble Gujarat High Court and various subordinate courts, the firm is recognised for its precision in drafting, strategic litigation, and effective advocacy.

Our expertise spans constitutional law, civil litigation, criminal matters, service and labour law, land and revenue disputes, and educational institution advisory. We represent clients before the Supreme Court of India, the High Court of Gujarat, District & Sessions Courts, and specialised tribunals including the NCLT, DRT, SAT, consumer commissions and revenue authorities.

At Mehta Lawyers, we believe that effective advocacy begins with meticulous preparation and a client-centric approach. We craft each petition, agreement, and representation with precision, backed by rigorous legal research and deep domain knowledge. Our firm also actively engages in policy-oriented representations and public interest litigations, contributing to institutional reforms and safeguarding citizens' rights.

Our clientele includes individuals, corporates, institutions, and NGOs across Gujarat and beyond. Guided by principles of integrity, efficiency, and professionalism, we strive to deliver legal solutions that are both strategic and result-oriented.

With a strong commitment to excellence, Mehta Lawyers continues to uphold its reputation as a trusted partner for clients seeking comprehensive, reliable, and impactful legal representation.

Our Advocates

Minds behind the practice.

Our advocates combine decades of courtroom experience with the academic rigour and strategic thinking modern legal practice demands.

Founder · Advocate

Saurabh J. Mehta

Advocate Saurabh J. Mehta founded Mehta Lawyers in 1998 and has since built a distinguished practice before the Hon'ble Gujarat High Court and various subordinate courts. With over 27 years of dedicated courtroom experience, he is recognised across the bar for his precision in drafting, strategic clarity, and effective advocacy.

His practice spans constitutional law, civil litigation, service and labour matters, and land and revenue disputes. He has appeared before the Supreme Court of India, the High Court of Gujarat, District & Sessions Courts, and specialised tribunals including the NCLT, DRT, SAT and consumer commissions.

Beyond regular litigation, Saurabh actively engages in policy-oriented representations and public interest litigation, contributing to institutional reforms and safeguarding citizens' rights.

Areas of Expertise

  • Constitutional Law
  • Service & Labour Law
  • Civil Litigation
  • Land & Revenue Disputes
  • Public Interest Litigation
  • Educational Advisory
Advocate

Mithil J. Mehta

Advocate Mithil J. Mehta is a key member of the firm's litigation team, with a growing practice across civil, criminal and commercial matters. He brings a contemporary approach to traditional advocacy — combining rigorous legal research with technology-driven case management.

His practice involves regular appearances before the High Court of Gujarat, District & Sessions Courts, and various tribunals. He focuses particularly on civil disputes, criminal defence, and commercial litigation, and contributes significantly to the firm's drafting and research work.

Mithil works closely with the firm's diverse clientele — from individual clients and start-ups to established corporates and institutions — ensuring each matter receives meticulous attention and a strategic, results-oriented approach.

Areas of Expertise

  • Civil Litigation
  • Criminal Defence
  • Commercial Disputes
  • Contract Law
  • Legal Research
  • Trial Advocacy
